name: reverseplugin
description: Native PE and IL2CPP analysis, process memory, and debugging tools exposed through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Native PE, IL2CPP, memory, and debugging tools over MCP.
interface.longDescription: A native C++23 MCP server for static PE and Unity IL2CPP analysis, structured Zydis disassembly, function and cross-reference discovery, persistent annotations, validated process-memory access, stack walking, and Win32 debugging. Compact metadata v38/v39 and matching x86-64 GameAssembly files can be dumped with native method RVAs without launching the game.
defaultPrompt: Open a PE binary and build a structured analysis plan.
Dump Unity IL2CPP metadata and map methods to GameAssembly addresses.
Inspect a Windows process without modifying it.
